name: Love Lost
overview: The Scriptures reveal that genuine love is evidenced by obedient faith and a transformed mind, as believers are called not merely to profess Christ but to do His will (Luke 6:46; Romans 12:2). True love produces the fruit of the Spirit, including patience and goodness (Galatians 5:22), and those who love God can trust that all things ultimately work together for their good (Romans 8:28). Prayer, empowered by the Spirit’s intercession, is a vital expression of this relationship, with the promise that believing prayer receives answers (Matthew 21:22; Romans 8:26). When love is lost, it reflects a failure to live in obedient faith and to walk in the Spirit’s renewing power.
